name: Quibi
summary: Short-form video platform launched during COVID, failed to find audience despite $1.75B funding.
lesson: Even massive funding can't fix product-market fit.

name: WeWork
summary: Coworking space giant collapsed after failed IPO revealed massive losses.
lesson: Growth without profitability is a countdown to collapse.

name: FTX
summary: Crypto exchange collapsed overnight, $8B customer funds missing.
lesson: Trust is everything in fintech. Governance failures kill fastest.

name: Theranos
summary: Blood-testing startup claimed revolutionary tech that didn't work.
lesson: Fake innovation eventually gets exposed.

name: Evaly
summary: Bangladeshi e-commerce platform collapsed after failing to deliver prepaid orders.
lesson: Cash-intensive models require strict financial discipline.

name: E-Orange
summary: E-commerce platform with aggressive discounts couldn't sustain operations.
lesson: Discount-led growth without margin kills you.

name: Chaldal
summary: Online grocery delivery survived but never achieved profitability at scale.
lesson: Unit economics beat growth in emerging markets.

name: Byju's
summary: EdTech giant collapsed after aggressive acquisitions and COVID-era correction.
lesson: Acquisitions without integration destroy value.

name: Dunzo
summary: Hyperlocal delivery startup burned cash for years, never found unit economics.
lesson: Delivery margins are brutal. Every order lost money.

name: GoMechanic
summary: Car servicing startup fabricated financials to raise funding.
lesson: Investors now do deeper due diligence on unit metrics.

name: BharatPe
summary: Fintech survived but co-founder litigation and governance failures damaged trust.
lesson: Founder disputes kill more than market forces.

name: Tokopedia
summary: Indonesia's biggest marketplace merged with Gojek after years of losses.
lesson: Mergers are often survival, not success.

name: JD.id
summary: JD.com's Indonesian arm shut down after struggling against Shopee and Tokopedia.
lesson: Global giants can lose local battles.

name: BliBli
summary: Indonesian marketplace pivoted to hybrid model to survive.
lesson: Pivots save more startups than they save products.

name: Airlift
summary: Pakistan's most-funded startup shut down when global VC funding dried up.
lesson: When the world tightens, cash-burning startups die first.

name: Daraz
summary: Alibaba-owned Daraz laid off large workforce and retreated from some markets.
lesson: Parent company strategy changes can kill your independence.

name: Careem Pakistan
summary: Careem exited Pakistan ride-hailing after Uber acquisition.
lesson: Acquisitions often mean local operations get shut down.

name: Jumia
summary: Africa's first unicorn faced fraud allegations and struggled for profitability.
lesson: Being first doesn't mean being profitable.

name: Konga
summary: Nigerian e-commerce giant sold to Zinox after cash crunch.
lesson: Acquisition at a loss is better than death.

name: Airlift (Nigeria)
summary: Nigerian logistics startup shut down after failing to raise next round.
lesson: Same failure mode across all emerging markets — cash.

name: Katerra
summary: Construction-tech unicorn raised $3B, ran out of cash after project losses.
lesson: Disrupting physical industries is harder than it looks.

name: Bird
summary: Scooter startup went public at $2.5B, then bankrupted in 2 years.
lesson: Scooters break. So do business models built on them.

name: Oyo China
summary: Indian hotel chain Oyo failed to replicate model in China.
lesson: What works in one market fails in another.

name: Wag Labs
summary: Dog-walking app raised huge capital, couldn't compete with Rover.
lesson: Winner-take-most markets reward #1 only.

name: Vine
summary: Twitter acquired Vine, then killed it despite massive user base.
lesson: Parent company priorities can kill great products.

name: Google+
summary: Google's social network couldn't beat Facebook despite unlimited resources.
lesson: Throwing money at Facebook doesn't work.

name: YouTube Originals
summary: YouTube shut down original content after Netflix-style strategy failed.
lesson: Platforms shouldn't try to be studios.

name: Google Stadia
summary: Cloud gaming platform killed by Google after 4 years of user complaints.
lesson: Gaming needs low latency. Cloud can't fix physics.

name: Meta Diem
summary: Facebook's cryptocurrency project killed by regulators before launch.
lesson: You can't ignore regulators, even at Meta's scale.

name: Amazon Care
summary: Amazon's telehealth service shut down within 3 years.
lesson: Amazon-sized resources can't buy product-market fit.

name: Olive AI
summary: Healthcare automation unicorn imploded after rapid layoffs and investigations.
lesson: $4B valuation doesn't mean $4B of reality.

name: Fast
summary: One-click checkout startup burned through $10M/month.
lesson: If you burn $10M/month, you need $100M+ revenue to survive.

name: Zume Pizza
summary: Robotic pizza company couldn't make automation work at scale.
lesson: Robots are hard. Pizza is harder.

name: Brooklinen
summary: DTC bedding brand struggled with customer acquisition costs.
lesson: DTC economics rarely work without massive scale.

name: Casper
summary: Mattress-in-a-box went public at $1B, then delisted below $100M.
lesson: If CAC > first-order profit, you're paying to grow.

name: Brandless
summary: $3-per-item brand shut down after SoftBank wrote it off.
lesson: Cheap isn't a strategy. Value is.

name: Sackcloth & Ashes
summary: Sustainable bedding brand couldn't scale beyond niche.
lesson: Sustainability alone doesn't sell.

name: The Fader
summary: Iconic music magazine shut down print, then digital.
lesson: Ad-supported media dies when Facebook eats ads.

name: Vice Media
summary: Media giant went from $5.7B valuation to bankruptcy.
lesson: Media needs scale or subscription — not both bets.

name: BuzzFeed News
summary: Pulitzer-winning news division closed after years of losses.
lesson: Journalism can't survive on ad clicks alone.

name: CNN+
summary: CNN's streaming service shut down after 32 days.
lesson: Streaming is brutal. Audiences don't switch easily.

name: Quirky
summary: Crowdsourced invention platform couldn't scale manufacturing.
lesson: Creative platforms need operational excellence.

name: Jawbone
summary: Fitness tracker pioneer lost to Fitbit and Apple Watch.
lesson: Pioneers rarely win the long game.

name: Pebble
summary: Kickstarter smartwatch darling sold to Fitbit at a loss.
lesson: Apple enters, you die.

name: Jibo
summary: Social robot for homes never found enough buyers.
lesson: Consumers don't buy robots they don't need.

name: Essential
summary: Andy Rubin's smartphone startup failed to ship second product.
lesson: Founder pedigree doesn't guarantee demand.

name: MoviePass
summary: $10/month movie subscription lost money on every ticket.
lesson: If every sale loses money, scale makes it worse.

name: Sinemia
summary: MoviePass competitor with same broken model shut down.
lesson: Learning from others' mistakes matters.

name: Kite
summary: AI coding assistant acquired by OpenAI, product killed.
lesson: Acquisitions often mean product death.

name: Neeva
summary: Ad-free search engine sold to Snowflake after failing to compete with Google.
lesson: You can't out-Google Google.

name: Nutanix (legacy)
summary: Hardware/software hybrid struggled to transition to pure SaaS.
lesson: Pivoting business models mid-flight is brutal.

name: Powa Technologies
summary: UK payments unicorn collapsed after fake revenue claims.
lesson: Valuation ≠ revenue.

name: Blippar
summary: AR unicorn failed to find real users.
lesson: AR hype ≠ AR users.

name: Kano
summary: DIY computer kit company acquired by STEM startup.
lesson: Niche hardware has a small ceiling.

name: Flirtey
summary: Drone delivery startup stalled by FAA regulations.
lesson: Regulation can pause your entire industry.

name: Kalo
summary: Freelancer management platform failed to scale.
lesson: Small markets kill small startups.

name: Ecometrica
summary: Sustainability SaaS struggled despite ESG hype.
lesson: Sustainability buyers are slow to decide.

name: Onfido (legacy)
summary: Identity verification startup acquired after years of losses.
lesson: Sometimes acquisition is the only exit.

name: Blippar AR
summary: Duplicate entry — repeated failure patterns.
lesson: Same story, different brand.

name: Kano Computing
summary: Coding kits for kids lost to Scratch and free tools.
lesson: Free competitors kill paid education.
